<compartment start="1781" end="1854" title="Inconclusive investigation into nightly training throughput drift" episode_type="investigation" importance="14">
<p1>
Nightly training runs have been ~7% slower on Tue/Wed for the last three weeks but back to baseline Thu–Mon. No code changes correlate. Looked at GPU utilization (steady), dataloader throughput (steady), network egress (unremarkable), shared-filesystem latency (no signal in our metrics), and cluster autoscaler activity (no correlation).

U: probably some other team's job is contending on the same nodes those days but I don't want to spend more time on it right now

Parking. If it gets worse or starts hitting Thu, revisit.
</p1>
<p2>
Investigated a recurring Tue/Wed ~7% training throughput drift; no signal in obvious metrics. Parked pending escalation.
</p2>
<p3>
Inconclusive performance investigation, parked.
</p3>
<p4/>
</compartment>

<compartment start="79" end="94" title="Auditable proration credit ledger" episode_type="design,feature,release" importance="86">
<p1>
U: "credits are money; don't hide them in metadata"

Built Billetto's proration credit flow around real ledger entries instead of Stripe invoice metadata. The new billing/src/credits/proration.ts calculates unused-time and downgrade credits against subscription_version, then writes account_credit_entries tied to invoice_line_id. U: "we need ledger lines you can audit in six months"

Retries reuse the same idempotency key and detect existing ledger entries instead of minting another credit. Added migration 202605101422_add_account_credit_entries.sql, rollback dry-run fixtures, and a release check that compares Stripe invoice totals against the local ledger. Commit 6c2d8ef.
</p1>
<p2>
Billetto proration credits are ledger entries because U: "credits are money; don't hide them in metadata". account_credit_entries ties credits to invoice_line_id and subscription_version for auditable retries.
</p2>
<p3>
Billetto made proration credits auditable by storing them in its own ledger table rather than Stripe metadata.
</p3>
<p4>account_credit_entries; subscription_version; proration idempotency key</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<PROJECT_RULES>
* Billetto billing migrations must include a rollback dry-run against test/fixtures/billing-ledger/.
</PROJECT_RULES>
<ARCHITECTURE>
* Billetto represents credits as account_credit_entries tied to invoice_line_id, not as Stripe metadata.
* Billetto proration calculation is idempotent around subscription_version and reuses existing ledger entries on retry.
</ARCHITECTURE>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* Stripe invoice metadata is not a durable Billetto credit ledger because dashboard edits can mutate it outside the app.
</CONSTRAINTS>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* Billetto credit_kind enum values are unused_time, plan_downgrade, and manual_adjustment.
* Billetto Stripe idempotency key format for proration is proration:{account_id}:{subscription_version}:{invoice_id}.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
<NAMING>
* The Billetto credit ledger table is named account_credit_entries; "negative_invoice_lines" was rejected.
</NAMING>
</facts>

<compartment start="15" end="22" title="Stopped contrastive loss cliff" episode_type="investigation,bug" importance="82">
<p1>
U: "can you chase the loss cliff, not tune around it"

Investigated Nereid's contrastive trainer after loss jumped from 0.42 to 3.8 around step 17.8k on A100 runs. The tempting path was LR tuning, but crop-hash logging showed duplicated augmentations across dataloader workers after worker_init_fn was dropped in 6fb2d90. Restored per-worker seeding in training/data/seed.py, added epoch_seed to the run manifest, and reran runs/2026-05-08/a100-bf16-rerun through 52k steps without the cliff. Commit c8e4a11.
</p1>
<p2>
Nereid's loss cliff was caused by shared augmentation seeds across dataloader workers, not optimizer settings. training/data/seed.py now derives worker seeds from base seed, worker id, and epoch.
</p2>
<p3>
Nereid contrastive training stabilized after restoring per-worker augmentation seeds.
</p3>
<p4>worker_init_fn; augmentation_seed; runs/2026-05-08/a100-bf16-rerun</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* Nereid's contrastive trainer can diverge if augmentation_seed is shared across dataloader workers.
</CONSTRAINTS>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* Nereid worker augmentation seed formula is base_seed + worker_id + epoch * 1009.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
</facts>
<events>
<causal_incident at_compartment="2">
  <summary>Training loss cliff traced to duplicated augmentation seeds.</summary>
  <affected_surface>other</affected_surface>
  <symptom>Contrastive loss jumped from 0.42 to 3.8 around step 17.8k on A100 runs.</symptom>
  <cause_summary>worker_init_fn had been removed, causing dataloader workers to reuse augmentation seeds.</cause_summary>
  <disposition>fixed</disposition>
  <evidence>Crop-hash logging showed duplicated augmentations across dataloader workers.</evidence>
  <fix_summary>Restored per-worker seed derivation in training/data/seed.py and recorded epoch_seed in run manifests.</fix_summary>
</causal_incident>
</events>

<compartment start="559" end="561" title="Oracle 对 f4b9546 判 FAIL：核验 BLOCKER 三项事实主张并修机械项" episode_type="investigation,bug" importance="45">
<p1>
Oracle 对 `f4b9546` 判 **VERDICT: FAIL**（1 BLOCKER + 1 IMPORTANT + 2 SUGGESTION），明言"**不可合入 dev**"。我逐条读码核实（不盲信也不盲驳），**BLOCKER 的三项事实主张全部成立**（我亲自取证）：① `assessment_analyze.py:63-69` 的 `_MARK_ANALYZING` 把 T05 置 `status='analyzing'`（执行于 `:655`），而端口调用在其后（`face.quality()` 在 `:248`、`skin.analyze()` 在 `:286`）⇒ hold 期间 T05 处于 `analyzing`；② `AssessmentAcceptanceService.java:241-243` 逐字为 `if (!"needs_retake".equals(row.status())) → reject(PHOTO_VERSION_CONFLICT, ...)` ⇒ 补拍只在 `needs_retake` 下允许；③ `test_sc0209_old_revision_released_does_not_overwrite_new_report` 确实用 `_seed_analysis_case(...status="analyzing")` + `mark_report_ready(...)` + `_enqueue_analyze(aid, 1)` **直接种库并手工入队旧代次**，非黑盒 HTTP 时序。⇒ 构成真实冲突：hold 住旧执行则 T05=analyzing、HTTP 补拍被拒；若先让 v1 落到 needs_retake，旧执行已原子完成、不存在"待释放的旧执行"。

同时确认 **IMPORTANT 成立**：`_env_bool`（`dconfig.py:148-152`）对任何非空未知值返回 `raw in ("1","true","yes","on")` ⇒ `MVP_D_FACE_DOUBLE_SAME_PERSON=bogus` 会静默变 false 并真的触发 NOT_SAME_PERSON 分支；`storage.py:23-26` 同病。**SUGGESTION 成立**：`git diff --check` 报 `FileSystemStorageDoubleFailModeTest.java:99: new blank line at EOF`（`od` 确认文件尾 `}\n}\n\n`）；文件数实为 **12**（我发给 Oracle 的任务书写了 13，是我的错；`B.md` 第 13 节写的 12 正确）。注意一处时序事实：Oracle 说"`f4b9546` 最终 39/39 尚未提供"是因为它在我**启动验收复跑之前**就已派发，我已在 `f4b9546` 取得 **ALL PASS 39/39 SCRIPT_RC=0**。先自行修掉 EOF 空行（机械修复），并派发 IMPORTANT 的严格布尔解析修复；BLOCKER 起初我拟升级请裁定。
</p1>
<p2>
Oracle 对 `f4b9546` 判 FAIL（1 BLOCKER + 1 IMPORTANT + 2 SUGGESTION）。我读码确认 BLOCKER 三项成立：hold 期间 T05=analyzing、A02 补拍仅允许 needs_retake、SC-02-09 测试种库伪造时序（`_seed_analysis_case`+`mark_report_ready`+`_enqueue_analyze`）。IMPORTANT 成立（`_env_bool` 把未知值当 false 并会真触发分支）；SUGGESTION 成立（EOF 空行、文件数实为 12）。修 EOF 空行、派发严格布尔修复。
</p2>
<p3>
Oracle 判 `f4b9546` FAIL，BLOCKER 认定进程级 hold 与状态机不相容；我核实三项事实主张成立后派发严格布尔修复。
</p3>
<p4>
f4b9546 FAIL; BLOCKER SC-02-09 hold vs 状态机; EOF 空行; 12 vs 13 文件
</p4>
</compartment>

<compartment start="562" end="578" title="总协调裁定 SC-02-09 需真实迟到返回；我纠正不可达论证并交付 barrier 与 SC-02-10 终态注入" episode_type="design,feature,bug" importance="68">
<p1>
[562] U: 总协调裁定——SC02-09 必须以**真实迟到返回**实现：旧算法调用已取得旧版本输入并延迟返回、待新版本成功后旧结果才返回，**不得以静态 revision 守卫代替证据**；明确允许**必要的 D 测试端口/适配上下文最小扩展**，但不改业务判定；优先"输入可识别标记 / 测试实例隔离的有界 barrier + 超时清理 + 生产禁用 + 无公共 HTTP 后门 + 不只改 DB"。两份复验手册须落盘本分支 `backend/handoffs/B-seam-repro.md` 随交付提交。

[563-565] 我先读码后得出**与裁定前提冲突的结论并如实上报**：`_retake_result`（`assessment_analyze.py:519-553`）返回 `HandlerResult(business_tx=tx)`，`tx` 内执行 `_MARK_RETAKE` ⇒ 按 `runtime/complete.py:179,187-189`（business_tx 先在同一连接/事务执行）`needs_retake` 与任务 `complete_success` **同事务原子提交**；而 `_mark_analyzing` 是自有短事务（`:239`），在调用 provider 前已提交 `analyzing`；A02 要求 `needs_retake` ⇒ 不存在"T05 已 needs_retake 且旧执行仍在飞"的窗口。`git diff --check 5bd22d3..HEAD` rc=0（`d312d2a` 已修 EOF 空行）。

[566-567] fix-2 的严格布尔解析修复终结：`strict_env_bool` 只接受 `1/true/yes/on` 与 `0/false/no/off`，未知值抛 `ProviderConfigError`；`REQUIRED_VIEWS=,,,` fail fast；`double_injection_overrides()` 与 `storage.py` 运行时读取复用同一解析（单一语义）。pytest 259 → **279 passed**；Oracle 4 条命令均 rc=1 且报错含变量名与值域。改动仅 `dconfig.py`/`media/storage.py`/`test_double_injection_seams.py`。

[568-574] 总协调指出候选路径——**租约过期后同一旧任务被另一执行者接管、接管者返回 needs_retake 而原 provider 仍在飞**——我**承认我此前的不可达论证没有覆盖它**。源码证据：`expire.py:41-47` 把 `status='running' AND lease_until < now` 重置 queued；`claim.py:26-41` 接管改写 `lease_owner`、`lease_revision+1`；`complete.py:179-186` business_tx 不符即抛 `StaleGeneration` 整体回滚；`assessment_analyze.py:176-190` 捕获记 `analyze.fenced_write_stale`；`_publish:705-727` 另有 processing_revision/report_ready 守卫；`config.py:24-25,70-75` 已有 `MVP_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS`/`MVP_WORKER_RENEW_INTERVAL_SECONDS` ⇒ **测试租约配置无需关闭租约机制**。我亲验 fix-2 严格布尔修复（4 条命令 rc=1）后提交 **`40f5fde`**（279 passed rc=0），派发 SC-02-09 barrier + SC-02-10 终态注入（同属 Python worker 写域，单道串行）。

[575-577] 系统提示"某作业无终结结果"与 Board `running [resumed]` 矛盾；我用只读 `task_status` 核实 fix-2 `state: busy`/idle 32s/possibly_stuck false，磁盘探针证实其正在活跃写入（`dconfig.py`/`providers.py`/新测试文件时间戳递进）⇒ **第三次确认为假信号**，不重派/不取消/不回退/不进入其写域。

[578] fix-2 终结两项：(A) `LateReturnBarrier`（`providers.py:163-229`）——文件态、一次性、有界、输入标记（照片内容 sha256）驱动的"先算后等"迟到返回；`os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL)` 建 `consumed`（接管者见之立即返回不被阻塞）、`FaceDouble.quality` 先算 `QualityResult` 再 `compute_then_wait`（不重算）、monotonic deadline + 0.1s 轮询、超时抛既有 `ProviderUnavailable`、`finally` 清理、**不触任何 DB**。(B) `MVP_D_SKIN_DOUBLE_INVALID`（`none|unknown_metric|out_of_range|bad_unit`），经既有 `_ContractViolation` 路径 **1 轮确定性**到达 `status='failed'`+`failure_code='PROVIDER_CONTRACT_VIOLATION'`。5 个新旋钮入 `DOUBLE_INJECTION_SWITCHES`。pytest 279 → **291 passed**。**如实标注 SC-02-09 整体未 PASS**：仅 worker 侧围栏子序列已实测可达（A_in_barrier→recover_expired→B_takeover→B_committed needs_retake→A_released_old_result→A_fenced StaleGeneration），步骤 4-5（Java HTTP）该道无法驱动。
</p1>
<p2>
总协调裁定 SC-02-09 必须真实迟到返回、不得用静态 revision 守卫，允许多个 D 测试端口/适配上下文最小扩展。我起初论证该时序结构性不可达（needs_retake 与 complete_success 同事务原子），但总协调指出租约过期+接管路径后**我承认论证范围有误**：`expire.py` 重置 running→queued、`claim.py` 接管 lease_revision+1、`complete.py` 的 StaleGeneration 围栏，使"接管者写 needs_retake 而原 provider 仍在飞"可达。提交严格布尔修复 `40f5fde`（279 passed）后派发 barrier + SC-02-10：`LateReturnBarrier` 文件态一次性先算后等不写 DB、`MVP_D_SKIN_DOUBLE_INVALID` 1 轮终态；291 passed；SC-02-09 整体未 PASS（Java 步骤留给 E）。
</p2>
<p3>
总协调裁定 SC-02-09 需真实迟到返回；我先误判不可达、后经总协调提示租约接管路径纠正，交付文件态 `LateReturnBarrier` 与 SC-02-10 确定性终态注入。
</p3>
<p4>
LateReturnBarrier; 40f5fde; 租约接管可达性; MVP_D_SKIN_DOUBLE_INVALID; 291 passed
</p4>
</compartment>

<compartment start="579" end="591" title="独立核验 barrier/SC-02-10 并提交 181676d；补齐 b40/b41 端到端工装" episode_type="feature,investigation" importance="60">
<p1>
我独立核验 fix-2 的 barrier 与 SC-02-10（不采信自报）：写域恰 `dconfig.py`/`providers.py` + 新测试（业务文件 diff 全空，含 `assessment_analyze.py`/`runtime/**`/`media/storage.py`/Java/acceptance）；`LateReturnBarrier` 用 `os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL)` 建 `consumed`（接管者见之立即返回）、标记取输入照片内容 sha256、先算后等、monotonic deadline 有界、`finally` 清理、不写任何 DB。我亲跑 pytest **291 passed rc=0**；守卫 CLI 七组符合预期（生产+barrier rc=1 且列明 switch、生产+全默认 rc=0、dev+全合法非默认 rc=0、缺 sha256/坏 sha/坏枚举/timeout=0 均 rc=1）。

核心测试方法论**确为真实围栏路径而非种库伪造时序**（Oracle 上轮正因种库判 BLOCKER）：`_seed_marked_case`（:114 明写"仅初始 fixture"）只建 v1 初始任务；随后 `claim_batch(worker_id="A", lease_seconds=1)` 真实领取、真实线程中 `handle` 先算出旧结果再阻塞、`_wait_file(consumed)` 确认已阻塞、`time.sleep(1.2)` 让短租约自然过期（未关闭续租机制：单次 handle 无续租线程）、`recover_expired` 真实回收并断言 `status='queued'`/`lease_owner is None`/`lease_revision+1`、再由 `claim_batch(worker_id="B", lease_seconds=60)` 真实接管。尾部断言真实非空跑：`complete_success` 对旧执行抛 `StaleGeneration`、`needs_retake` 未被覆盖、`report_id`/`report_payload`/`member_id` 为 null、`report_ready` 行数 0、无 sentinel 残留。SC-02-10 断言 `attempt_count==1`、`failure_code=PROVIDER_CONTRACT_VIOLATION`、`async_jobs` 计数 == 1、`report_ready`=0。提交 **`181676d`**（相对 `5bd22d3` 13 文件/+2370−11，diff-check rc=0）。

随后派发 b40/b41 端到端工装（步骤 4-5 属 Java HTTP，Python 道无法驱动；该证据须由我自有验收工装 `backend/tests/**` 产出，否则 Oracle 极可能再判"未证明真实可驱动"）。[591] fix-2 终结：`backend/tests/run-acceptance-b.sh` + `support/b-checks-3.sh` 新增 **b40**（SC-02-09 真实迟到返回：A01 → A 在飞 → 租约过期 `--recover` → B 接管写 needs_retake → A02 v2 → C 发布 → 释放 A → 旧执行被 `job.complete_stale_generation` 围栏拒绝、v2 快照不变）与 **b41**（SC-02-10 终态 + M3-A03 投影一致）。完整工装 **41/41 ALL PASS SCRIPT_RC=0**（b36 Java 419/0/0、b37 Python 291/0/0）。
</p1>
<p2>
我独立核验 barrier 与 SC-02-10：写域仅 `dconfig.py`/`providers.py`+测试，`LateReturnBarrier` 一次性先算后等不写 DB，测试走真实 `claim/recover/handle/complete` 围栏（`_seed_marked_case` 仅初始 fixture）且尾部断言 `StaleGeneration` 与快照不变；291 passed。提交 `181676d` 后派发 b40/b41：b40 端到端真实迟到返回、b41 终态+M3-A03 投影，工装 **41/41 SCRIPT_RC=0**。
</p2>
<p3>
核验 barrier/SC-02-10 后提交 181676d；b40/b41 端到端工装补齐，41/41 全绿。
</p3>
<p4>
181676d; b40/b41; 41/41; LateReturnBarrier 真实围栏路径
</p4>
</compartment>

<compartment start="592" end="597" title="核验 b40/b41 红线并提交最终代码 SHA 8343ba5，送 Oracle 有界复审" episode_type="investigation,release" importance="62">
<p1>
我独立核验 b40/b41，重点三条红线：**有无直接改 DB 伪造时序**、**b1–b39 断言有无弱化**、**亲跑工装**。grep 命中的 `UPDATE async_jobs`/`INSERT INTO` 全在既有检查区（第 107/129/141/157/200/258 行），而新增代码区从 **315 行**起（`b_drain_queue`）、b40 在 384、b41 在 505 ⇒ **新增区零业务表写入**；`b_drain_queue` 用真实 `-m mvp_worker --once` 消费（注释明写"不直接改状态"）；`psql_b` 调用全为 SELECT。b1–b39 无断言被弱化（删除行仅 3 行头注释改名，numstat +14/−2 与 +266/−1）。b40 的后台 Worker A 有专门回收钩子（pid + kill + 10s 等待 + kill -9）。我亲跑完整工装 **ALL PASS 41/41 SCRIPT_RC=0**（跑后 18083/18084 空闲、无遗留 JVM）。提交工装，**本轮最终代码 SHA = `8343ba5`**（相对 `5bd22d3` 15 文件/+2650−14，diff-check rc=0），送 ora-1 只读复审（授权其可跑测试并独占 18083/18084）。

趁复审期间我把 `B-seam-repro.md`（含最终绑定 SHA、b40 实测中间态表与 E 可照抄的 9 步复验序列、等价性说明、双重围栏如实记录、进程卫生）与 `B.md` 13.10/13.11 补齐到当前事实，并更正"端到端缺口"为已闭合并附红线核实（新增区零业务表写入、`psql_b` 全 SELECT、b1–b39 断言零改动），同时明记**场景最终结算由 E 在其 matrix 完成、B 不代 E 宣布 PASS**。
</p1>
<p2>
我核验 b40/b41：新增区零业务表写入、`psql_b` 全 SELECT、b1–b39 断言零改动，亲跑 41/41 SCRIPT_RC=0；提交最终代码 SHA `8343ba5`（15 文件/+2650−14）并送 Oracle 只读复审；同步补齐 `B-seam-repro.md` 与 `B.md` 13.10/13.11。
</p2>
<p3>
核验红线后提交最终代码 SHA 8343ba5，送 Oracle 有界复审，并补齐两份交付文档。
</p3>
<p4>
8343ba5; 15 文件 +2650−14; b40/b41; 41/41
</p4>
</compartment>

<p1>

<p1>

fix-4 终结：`ApiDocsApplier`(809 行，OpenApiCustomizer/Ordered ORDER=200) + `ErrorCodeDocs`(29 个 `ErrorCode` 中文语义/触发/动作，纠正我任务书的「30」) + `ApiDocsApplierTest`(8 项纯单元含负向) + `ApiDocsCoverageIT`(覆盖率门禁，当前**预期失败 639 项**) + `OpenApiDocsConfig` 重组（info 联调导读、customizer 排序）；临时样例目录已删除并重建 jar。自报 compile/package rc=0、定向 19/0/0、全量去门禁 427/0/0（基线 419+8）。

* 列表响应端点文档必须用 `SuccessDoc.jsonList(code, description, itemClass)`（引擎 `listItemClass` 分支，四形态优先级 `listItemClass > contentType > dataClass > 皆 null`），不得用 `json(..., ListData.class)`——`ListData<T>` 是 record（`cn.yuanxin.mvp.web.web.ListData`）不可继承，泛型擦除会让 `items` 退化且条目 DTO 不进 components。

</ARCHITECTURE>
